notes: Because 是 (shì) is in the fourth tone, 不 (bù) changes to the rising second tone: bú shì (often with a neutral tone on shi in fast speech).
As a standalone 'no', 不是 corrects an assumption ('that's not true'); it is not used to refuse an offer or request.
